description: Work out the least notice the law requires to end employment in any UK nation, from the employer and from the employee, from the start date and the day notice is given. A contract can require more notice, never less.

given.description: The day notice is given, as YYYY-MM-DD.

nation.description: The UK nation where the employee mainly works.

started.description: The day the employee started working for the employer, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: check_statutory_notice
title: Statutory notice check
